editorNote: A Saturday edition built from headline-level reporting only, as article text was not retrievable: Rocket Lab's Iridium deal draws a challenge, gold probes $4,000, and Alibaba and bitcoin remain soft. Nothing here is investment advice.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab's worst week on record: an AST SpaceMobile partner challenges the Iridium deal
stories.summary: A Stocktwits headline says RKLB had its worst week ever after an AST SpaceMobile partner challenged Rocket Lab's planned Iridium purchase, claiming a rival uses the FCC to block competitors. A Motley Fool headline notes Iridium beat earnings. Article text was not retrievable, so no figures are given.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headlines, the Iridium acquisition now faces a public challenge tied to FCC process, a new development beyond this paper's earlier coverage of the stock's slide.

sourceLinks.title: RKLB Stock Suffers Worst Week Ever: AST SpaceMobile Partner Challenges Iridium Deal — Claims Rival Uses FCC To Block Competitors - Stocktwits
Rocket Lab Is Buying Iridium, and Guess What? Iridium Just Beat Earnings! - The Motley Fool

stories.headline: Gold tests $4,000 support as bearish gaps point to downside risk, Investing.com says
stories.summary: An Investing.com headline dated Oct. 24 says gold is testing $4,000 support, with bearish gaps signalling further downside risks. Article text was not retrievable, so no further levels are reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headline, the metal has slid further from the roughly $4,100 level this paper reported on Oct. 22.

sourceLinks.title: Gold Price Tests $4,000 Support as Bearish Gaps Signal Further Downside Risks - Investing.com

stories.headline: Alibaba ADR underperforms peers on Friday, MarketWatch reports
stories.summary: MarketWatch headlines dated Oct. 23 say Alibaba's ADR underperformed competitors on Friday; GuruFocus separately lists Alibaba as falling while TSMC rose among Chinese stocks. Article text was not retrievable, so no price figures are given.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headlines, the weakness continues the China tech pressure covered earlier in the week.

stories.headline: Bitcoin is down in October despite 'Uptober' hopes, with a Motley Fool piece listing reasons for optimism
stories.summary: A Motley Fool headline says bitcoin may be down in October and offers three reasons to stay bullish; a Yahoo Finance headline asks what happens if this cycle breaks the pattern of bottoming after US midterm elections. Article text was not retrievable; the optimism is the outlets' opinion, not a forecast we endorse.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headlines, bitcoin's October has fallen short of its seasonal reputation.
